nameOverride.description: Partially override the chart name used in resource names

fullnameOverride.description: Fully override the resource name prefix

commonLabels.description: Labels added to all resources (template). The standard `app.kubernetes.io` labels cannot be overridden.

commonAnnotations.description: Annotations added to all resources and to the pods (template). Annotations set on a resource take precedence.

replicas.description: Number of gateway pods (ignored when `autoscaling.enabled` is true)

registry.description: Gateway image registry. Set it to your own registry when you mirror the image.

repository.description: Gateway image repository, without the registry

tag.description: Gateway image tag, defaults to the chart `appVersion`

digest.description: Gateway image digest, for example `sha256:abc...`. It takes precedence over the tag.

imagePullSecrets.description: Secrets used to pull the image, same structure as `spec.imagePullSecrets` in a Pod

apisixYaml.description: Content of `apisix.yaml`, ignored when `existingConfigMap` or `existingSecret` is set

existingConfigMap.description: Name of an existing ConfigMap that contains the `apisix.yaml` file

existingSecret.description: Name of an existing Secret that contains the `apisix.yaml` file (takes precedence over `existingConfigMap`)

key.description: Key of the `apisix.yaml` file in the ConfigMap or Secret

enable_server_tokens.description: Show the APISIX version in the `Server` header (we do not want to leak it)

enable_http2.description: Enable HTTP/2 on the TLS listener

extra_lua_path.description: Extra Lua module search path, used for the plugins baked into the image

ssl_ciphers.description: Supported TLSv1.2 cipher suites. The APISIX default list trips security scanners.

ssl_session_tickets.description: Use TLS session tickets (they defeat perfect forward secrecy)

error_log.description: Location of the error log. Log to stderr, the log directory is a pod local `emptyDir`.

worker_shutdown_timeout.description: Time workers get to finish requests on shutdown or reload, after which open connections are closed. Keep it below `terminationGracePeriodSeconds` minus the `preStop` sleep (10s).

http_configuration_snippet.description: Raw nginx configuration added to the `http` block

http_server_configuration_snippet.description: Raw nginx configuration added to the `server` block

plugins.description: Enabled plugins. Custom (WeAreFrank) plugins must be listed here too or APISIX does not load them. [array]

http.description: Port of the plain HTTP listener in the container (must be above 1024, the container runs as non-root)

https.description: Port of the HTTPS listener in the container

env.description: Environment variables of the gateway container, same structure as `env` in a container (template). Use it to feed `${{NAME}}` placeholders in `apisix.yaml`.

default: sleep 10; openresty -p /usr/local/apisix -s quit; while kill -0 "$(cat /usr/local/apisix/logs/nginx.pid 2>/dev/null)" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; done

envFrom.description: Sources for environment variables, same structure as `envFrom` in a container (template)

command.description: Override the command of the gateway container. The image's own entrypoint is used when empty.

args.description: Override the arguments of the gateway container

startupProbe.description: Startup probe of the gateway container

volumes.description: Additional volumes of the pod, same structure as `volumes` in a Pod (template)

volumeMounts.description: Additional volume mounts of the gateway container, same structure as `volumeMounts` in a container (template)

initContainers.description: Additional init containers, they run after the chart's own `prepare-conf` init container (template)

command.description: Command to run in diagnostic mode

args.description: Arguments of the command in diagnostic mode

externalTrafficPolicy.description: `Cluster` or `Local`, only used for `NodePort` and `LoadBalancer`. Unset by default.

loadBalancerClass.description: Load balancer implementation, only used for `LoadBalancer`

loadBalancerSourceRanges.description: Client CIDRs allowed to use the load balancer, only used for `LoadBalancer`

externalIPs.description: IP addresses outside the cluster on which the Service is also available, same as `spec.externalIPs`

ipFamilyPolicy.description: `SingleStack`, `PreferDualStack` or `RequireDualStack`, same as `spec.ipFamilyPolicy`. Unset by default.

ipFamilies.description: IP families of the Service, `IPv4` and or `IPv6`, same as `spec.ipFamilies`

internalTrafficPolicy.description: `Cluster` or `Local`, same as `spec.internalTrafficPolicy`. Unset by default.

sessionAffinity.description: `None` or `ClientIP`, same as `spec.sessionAffinity`. Unset by default.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Time Kubernetes waits for the gateway to stop. It covers the 10 second `preStop` sleep plus `config.nginx_config.worker_shutdown_timeout`, after which Kubernetes kills the container.

name.description: Name of the service account, generated when empty and `create` is true

automountServiceAccountToken.description: Mount the service account token in the pod. The gateway does not talk to the Kubernetes API.

defaultBackendPort.description: Name of the port in `service.ports` used by paths without a `backend`

tls.description: Ingress TLS settings, same structure as `spec.tls` in an Ingress (template)

parentRefs.description: Gateways to attach to, same structure as `spec.parentRefs` (template). Required.

defaultBackendPort.description: Name of the port in `service.ports` used by rules without `backendRefs`

apiVersion.description: API version of the TLSRoute, detected from the cluster when empty (`v1`, otherwise `v1alpha2`)

parentRefs.description: Gateways (listeners with TLS mode `Passthrough`) to attach to, same structure as `spec.parentRefs` (template). Required.

hostnames.description: SNI hostnames to match, same as `spec.hostnames` (template). Required.

defaultBackendPort.description: Name of the port in `service.ports` used by rules without `backendRefs`

behavior.description: Scaling behavior, same structure as `spec.behavior` in an `autoscaling/v2` HorizontalPodAutoscaler

port.description: Container port of the Control API

type.description: Service type of the Control API Service

port.description: Service port of the Control API

annotations.description: Annotations of the Control API Service

labels.description: Labels of the Control API Service

enabled.description: Serve Prometheus metrics and create the metrics Service

port.description: Container and Service port of the metrics endpoint

namespace.description: Namespace of the ServiceMonitor, the release namespace when empty

labels.description: Labels of the ServiceMonitor, for example the label your Prometheus selects on

jobLabel.description: Label of the Service whose value becomes the `job` label, `spec.jobLabel`. Unset by default.

honorLabels.description: Keep the labels of the scraped metrics when they conflict with the target labels

relabelings.description: Relabelings, same structure as in a ServiceMonitor endpoint

metricRelabelings.description: Metric relabelings, same structure as in a ServiceMonitor endpoint

unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy.description: Whether unready pods can be evicted: `AlwaysAllow` or `IfHealthyBudget`, empty to leave it unset. Only rendered on Kubernetes 1.27 or newer.

from.description: Peers that may reach the Control API port (template). Needs `control.enabled`.
Peers that may reach the metrics port (template). Needs `metrics.enabled`.

extraIngress.description: Additional ingress rules, same structure as `spec.ingress` in a NetworkPolicy (template)

extraObjects.description: Additional Kubernetes objects to deploy with the release. Each item is an object or a string, and is rendered as a template.
